text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond defeated Kitasan Black and 
claimed 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an interview, Satono Diamond was asked 
about her next plans. Just then, Kitasan 
Black suggested they face each other in 
the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond agreed, and the crowd went 
wild over the upcoming rematch between the 
two.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to the waiting room, Satono 
Diamond said: Kitasan Black has already 
contributed to the Umamusume world simply 
by getting the crowd so excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, what should she accomplish as a 
"Notable Umamusume"? She stated that, 
taking cues from Kitasan Black, she wants 
to reflect on how she ought to carry 
herself.
